# 584. Aktierna Marcus Hernhag fyndköper

**Feed**: sparpodden  
**Published**: 2026-10-12  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Marcus Hernhag, a dividend-focused investor and author, talks about investor psychology. He describes how a narrow rally in US tech and Swedish banks and industrials has left many quality stocks far behind, and how hard it is mentally to hold dividend stocks through long periods of underperformance. He favours buying beaten-down quality companies that show value creation per share over time, naming AAK, Latour, Beijer Ref, Lime, Vitec and Cibus. He avoids companies with a state as a major owner, frequent strategy changes or hard-to-understand cases, such as Fortum, Telia, Neste, Stora Enso, Novo Nordisk and SBB-related property companies.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 AAK — AAK | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Shares fell after a margin dip and are cheaper than in years; cash flow improved; long record of value creation per share.

#### Reasoning

Guest thinks the market is overreacting to a temporary margin dip. AAK has historically created value per share and cash flow just improved, so he sees the pullback as an entry point for a long-term holder.

#### Sell Triggers

- if margins fail to recover over several years
- if value creation per share stops

> *"Fettillverkaren, AAK, har lite svacka med marginalen senast. Det är inga problem på sikt om man tittar på flera år."*

---

### 🟢 LATO-B — Latour | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Cheaper than in years and the premium to net asset value is gone; the industrial cycle should come back.

#### Reasoning

The investment company now trades without its historical premium. Guest expects its industrial operations to benefit when the economy turns up and thinks patience will pay off well.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the industrial recovery fails to materialise
- if net asset value per share stops growing

> *"Sen är det billigare än på länge och man har tålamod. Jag tror det kommer att löna sig väldigt bra förr eller senare."*

---

### 🟢 BEIJ-B — Beijer Ref | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Valuation roughly halved while the company keeps growing; becomes more buy-worthy as the valuation falls.

#### Reasoning

The quality company keeps growing a few percent a year while its P/E has compressed. Guest monthly-saves in cheap quality stocks like this that have lagged and expects the de-rating not to last forever.

#### Sell Triggers

- if growth stalls
- if the valuation re-inflates to 2021 levels

> *"det blir bara mer och mer köpvärt i takt med att värderingarna sjunker"*

---

### 🟢 LIME — Lime Technologies | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

SaaS valuations have collapsed, but it pays a dividend every year and keeps growing; AI is not seen as a threat.

#### Reasoning

Guest argues the SaaS de-rating overshoots. Brand, customer data and reliability protect the business from AI disruption, while dividends and growth continue.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI competitors start taking customers
- if growth or dividends stop

> *"Lime Technologies och Witex software har ju utdelningar varenda år och de fortsätter växa."*

---

### 🟢 VIT-B — Vitec Software | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Temporary margin dip, keeps growing and paying dividends; guest does not believe AI will replace it.

#### Reasoning

Guest calls this a temporary problem within the SaaS de-rating. Vitec's long-term growth and dividend record remain intact, and he thinks its customer knowledge protects it from AI rivals.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the margin dip becomes structural
- if AI erodes the customer base

> *"Framförallt för Witex så hoppar ju marginalerna till lite grann, en liten svacka där och så, men på sikt kommer de ju att fortsätta växa."*

---

### 🟢 CIBUS — Cibus Nordic | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Guest moved money into it: stable grocery-store properties and cash flow, despite high debt and short interest.

#### Reasoning

He understands the case: stable grocery-anchored properties. The risks are high debt with rising rates, short interest and no clear main owner. If it stops aggressive expansion and focuses on trimming, he expects it to do well.

#### Sell Triggers

- if market rates keep rising sharply
- if it continues aggressive debt-funded expansion

> *"Jag köper hellre aktier i Cibus Nordic."*

---

### 🟡 AKRBP — Aker BP | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

One of the guest's largest holdings; a hedge against inflation and higher fuel prices.

#### Reasoning

He prefers a large, safe oil company over complex energy-transition plays like Neste. It is more predictable and works as personal-finance insurance against higher petrol prices.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the oil price collapses structurally

> *"Jag har Aker BP ett av mina större innehav. Det är en bra försäkring mot inflation och dyrare bensin."*

---

### 🟡 ABBV — AbbVie | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Guest owns it; big pharma where buying pullbacks has paid off.

#### Reasoning

He prefers diversified big pharma with several therapy areas over the more concentrated Novo Nordisk.

#### Sell Triggers

- if value creation per share stalls

> *"Jag äger Abvi och det duger bra."*

---

### 🟠 ALFA — Alfa Laval | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 55%

A fantastic company that grows per share almost every year; buy it in a downturn when the share price is depressed.

#### Reasoning

Steady value creation per share means the share price follows over time, so the guest sees downturns as buying opportunities rather than buying now.

#### Sell Triggers

- if growth per share stops

> *"Alfa Laval, ett fantastiskt bra bolag. ... Köp den i lågkonjunktur när kursen är pressad."*

---

### 🟡 MU — Micron | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Small position held as a hedge against memory-chip price inflation; capacity is booked for 1-2 years, but the profit surge is unsustainable.

#### Reasoning

The guest owns it as insurance, not a trend bet. Profit grew elevenfold and the industry is sold out for 1-2 years, but he questions how long it can last.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the memory capacity shortage ends
- if AI data-centre investment slows

> *"Jag köpte lite micro-technology för att hedga mig mot inflation för att det blir så dyra minneskretsar."*

---

### 🟡 EVO — Evolution | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Leading product, but the growing black market and currency headwinds are concerns; guest keeps a small position.

#### Reasoning

He believes in its industry leadership and long-term share gains from land-based casinos, but is unsure when growth resumes, so he stays half-optimistic with a small position.

#### Sell Triggers

- if black-market growth keeps eroding the regulated market
- if growth fails to resume

> *"Jag är halvoptimist men vågar inte köpa själv med något stort belopp."*

---

### 🟠 KINV-B — Kinnevik | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Starting to look brighter with a new strategy and the right CEO, but it must prove itself; guest has no position.

#### Reasoning

The plan to find a wholly owned cash cow is promising, but the record of the last decade is weak. Guest would get interested if it shows stable cash generation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if it keeps funding cash-burning companies
- if no cash-cow acquisition materialises

> *"jag tror det är rätt VD och rätt inställning nu igen i alla fall"*

---

### 🟠 NOVO-B — Novo Nordisk | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Should be a bargain after the fall, but the news flow is unclear and it is changing everything at once; guest dares not buy.

#### Reasoning

New board, new CEO, large bids, reorganisation and cost cuts make the historical record less reliable. It is also concentrated in diabetes and obesity, so he watches from the sidelines.

#### Sell Triggers

- if competition from Lilly erodes its position

> *"Jag vågar inte köpa eller rekommendera Novo."*

---

### ⛔ FORTUM — Fortum | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Avoided because the Finnish state is a major owner.

#### Reasoning

Guest rules out companies with a state as a major owner even if Nordic power prices may be high.

> *"Nej jag orkar inte ha finska staten som..."*

---

### ⛔ TELIA — Telia | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Avoided because of state ownership; he would want a private owner, as at Tele2 and Millicom.

#### Reasoning

State owners have strategic, not shareholder-value, goals. He would reconsider if the state sold to an active private owner.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Swedish state sells to a private owner

> *"Nej, ingen stat som storägare det går inte."*

---

### ⛔ NESTE — Neste | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Sold: hard-to-understand margins and the share kept falling despite many deals.

#### Reasoning

He could not understand or trust the business, so he prefers a stable oil company.

> *"Jag är väldigt glad jag sålde i Finsta."*

---

### ⛔ STE-R — Stora Enso | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Shifting forest strategy and little value creation; guest gave up and sold.

#### Reasoning

A strategy that changes back and forth is a warning sign. Holmen and SCA are cited as more consistent alternatives.

> *"jag gav upp i Stora Enso och sålde och det var jag glad för"*

---

### ⛔ PPI — Public Property Invest | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

New listing in the SBB sphere; guest avoids all of these for simplicity.

#### Reasoning

Cross-holdings within the SBB sphere and large discounts to net asset value make the case complex.

> *"Jag undviker alla dem faktiskt bara för enkelhetens skull."*

---

### ⛔ HM-B — H&M | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Guest sold around 220 SEK years ago; margins are now about half their old level of 20%.

#### Reasoning

Years of falling margins while management only talked. Margins are only now recovering from the bottom.

> *"jag sålde H&amp, för 220 eller något, och de är ju fortfarande långt under den kursen"*

---

### ⛔ SIVE — Sivers | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

No earnings-per-share growth; everything rests on the future, so buying the dip is dangerous.

#### Reasoning

Retail owners kept piling in after the peak. Without earnings, buying the dip is far riskier than in a company like Alfa Laval.

> *"Just Sivers har ju ingen tillväxt eller vinst per aktie som stiger över sikt. Där bygger allt på framtid och då är det farligare."*

---
